text_block_list.text:
Starting today is the "Summer Training Camp"—
An important event that will influence upcoming races.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yay! It's been so long since our last training camp~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The beach, summer festivals, and watermelon splitting!
I'm gonna enjoy this year to the absolute fullest!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, just kidding!
Of course, training is the most important thing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna work super hard to get stronger,
so make sure you keep up with me, Trainer!

And just like that, for the first time in a year,
summer training camp with Tokai Teio begins!!
